native.http_version: Actual protocol version, unknown. Different text/binary/QUIC framing and flow control; no latest-version default.
native.http_transport: Actual selected transport, unknown. HTTP2TCP and HTTP3QUIC differ; HTTP1 custom reliable transport needs matched implementation source.
native.http_binding_source: Required actual registered TCP/TLS or QUIC/IP/physical path and peer endpoints, unknown; no automatic Ethernet100M or TCP mapping for all versions.
native.http_implementation_source: Required actual client/server/proxy version, supported negotiated protocol and resource limits, unknown.
native.http_schedule_source: Required actual handshake/application/flow-control/transport recovery/concurrency schedule evidence, unknown; HTTP defines no universal deadline.
native.http_role: Actual endpoint role, unknown. Response, push and settings direction depend on role; proxy requires each actual leg.
native.http_message_kind: Actual message direction; method/status/body semantics differ.
native.http_scheme: Actual origin scheme, unknown. Default ports80/443 are proposals only when origin has no explicit port, not all endpoints.
native.http_port_explicit: Whether actual origin contains explicit port, unknown; false permits scheme-default proposal, never overwrites explicit13500 etc.
native.http_port: Actual endpoint port, unknown; scheme-default80/443 proposal only when port elided.
native.http_origin: Actual http(s) origin/resource URI, unknown; nonempty host, no embedded credentials or fragment. Request-target forms are separate.
native.http_method: Actual case-sensitive method token, unknown; extension tokens allowed, no universal GET command.
native.http_status: Actual response status100..599; unknown/reserved3-digit statuses retain class semantics. Not mandatory for requests.
native.http_target_form: Actual HTTP1 request-target form. CONNECT authority, OPTIONS asterisk and proxy absolute target differ from HTTP2/3 pseudoheaders.
native.http_target_source: Actual URI/Host/:authority/:scheme/:path and target normalization/route evidence, unknown; no automatic URL constructed from device name.
native.http_tls_version: Actual negotiated security version, unknown. HTTP3 QUICv1 TLS1.3; HTTP2TLS at least1.2; actual certificate/ALPN acceptance separate.
native.http_security_source: Actual negotiated TLS/QUIC certificate/origin authentication/ALPN/cipher/0RTT policy evidence, unknown.
native.http_framing: Actual selected message framing. HTTP1 chunk/close differ from HTTP2/3 stream framing; successful CONNECT becomes tunnel.
native.http_transfer_encoding: Actual HTTP1 Transfer-Encoding final coding; not content compression. HTTP2/3 forbid Transfer-Encoding, though TE:trailers differs.
native.http_transfer_source: Actual transfer coding chain/chunk extensions/final terminator/trailers source, unknown; raw byte parsing not proven by counters.
native.http_content_length_present: Actual presence of Content-Length, unknown. Sender must not combine with Transfer-Encoding; HEAD/304 may report selected-representation length.
native.http_content_length: Actual nonnegative decimal Content-Length with no protocol-wide upper bound; text preserves arbitrary exact digits without JS precision loss.
native.http_length_semantics: Actual Content-Length semantic target, unknown; HEAD/304 metadata can differ from transmitted empty content.
native.http_body_bytes: Actual transmitted content octets as exact decimal text. No65535 maximum or8-byte default; excludes chunk framing and HTTP2 padding.
native.http_wire_message_bytes: Actual whole encoded HTTP message/stream octets as exact decimal text, unknown. Compression/headers/chunks/frame boundaries are not inferred from content.
native.http_encoding_source: Actual encoded content/header/trailer/chunk/HPACK/QPACK representation and whole message evidence, unknown.
native.http_acceptance_source: Actual application acceptance/units/idempotence/retries/cache/proxy/response correlation evidence, unknown; transport delivery is not functional acceptance.
native.http_request_timeout_ms: Actual implementation/application request deadline, unknown; no universal HTTP100/500ms standard.
native.http_retry_limit: Actual application retry policy and idempotence/source evidence, unknown; HTTP retries differ from TCP/QUIC retransmission.
native.http_retry_source: Actual method idempotence/replay/partial-processing and retry acceptance evidence, unknown. A lost response does not prove request was not applied.
native.http_transition_optimistic: Actual optimistic HTTP1 Upgrade/CONNECT behavior, unknown; RFC9931 requires explicit safety relative to possible HTTP misinterpretation.
native.http_transition_source: Actual negotiated transition/confirmation and harmless-prefix/smuggling risk evidence per RFC9931, unknown; tunnel is not auto-safe.
native.http2_frame_type: Actual HTTP2 frame type, unknown; fixed-type payloads and stream scope differ.
native.http2_stream_id: Actual31-bit HTTP2 stream ID; DATA/HEADERS on nonzero streams; connection frames stream0. No defaultassigned stream1.
native.http2_frame_header_bytes: HTTP2 fixed9-octet header proposal only for actual HTTP2. Excluded from SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZE.
native.http2_frame_payload_bytes: Actual24-bit HTTP2 frame payload, incl padding/pad length if used; at most actual receiver-advertised max, distinct from content/message.
native.http2_frame_bytes: Actual HTTP2 frame9+payload octets; not TCP segment or Ethernet frame length.
native.http2_settings_phase: Actual settings state. Normative initial values can be proposed only before peer values are supplied; never overwrite peer advertisements.
native.http2_max_frame_size: Actual peer SETTINGS_MAX_FRAME_SIZE range16384..16777215; initial16384 proposal. Not message-body maximum.
native.http2_header_table_size: Actual HPACK SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE uint32, initial4096 proposal; negotiated decoder context differs from uncompressed field size.
native.http2_initial_window_size: Actual SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE stream limit, initial65535 proposal; current stream/connection windows change independently.
native.http2_current_stream_window: Actual remaining stream flow-control window. Can be negative after SETTINGS decrease; negative window permits no DATA, no unsigned fallback.
native.http2_current_connection_window: Actual remaining connection DATA window; initial65535, WINDOW_UPDATE changes it. Not changed by stream SETTINGS.
native.http2_enable_push: Actual SETTINGS_ENABLE_PUSH0/1; initialclient1, serverinitial value has no effect equivalent0. Actual support/state required.
native.http2_max_concurrent_streams: Actual advertised uint32 limit, initially unlimited if absent; no fabricated100/256-stream maximum.
native.http2_max_header_list_bytes: Actual advisory uncompressed field-list limit incl32bytes per field; initially unlimited if absent, not a zero-byte default.
native.http2_pad_length_present: Actual PADDED flag and one-byte PadLength presence for DATA/HEADERS/PUSH_PROMISE, unknown.
native.http2_padding_bytes: Actual padding octets0..255 when PADDED, excluding1-byte PadLength; all are part of frame payload and DATA flow-control cost.
native.http2_data_bytes: Actual content inside DATA frame excluding padding/PadLength; distinct from complete message content and receiver window cost.
native.http3_frame_type: Actual QUIC-varint HTTP3 frame type0..2^62-1 as exact decimal text. Separate registry from HTTP2.
native.http3_frame_length: Actual QUIC-varint HTTP3 frame payload length0..2^62-1 as exact decimal text; no9-byte header or16384 maximum inherited from HTTP2.
native.http3_stream_kind: Actual QUIC stream kind: DATA/HEADERS request or push; SETTINGS control. QPACK streams are independent byte streams.
native.http3_qpack_max_table: Actual SETTINGS_QPACK_MAX_TABLE_CAPACITY uint62 as exact decimal text, initial0; not HTTP2 HPACK4096 default.
native.http3_qpack_blocked_streams: Actual SETTINGS_QPACK_BLOCKED_STREAMS uint62 as exact decimal text, initial0; blocking/recovery remains actual QUIC/QPACK schedule.
native.http3_max_field_section_bytes: Actual advertised uint62 maximum field-section size as exact decimal text; absent means unlimited, not0 or HTTP2 frame-size limit.
native.http3_settings_phase: Actual HTTP3 settings state.1RTT initial defaults differ from remembered0RTT peer values; do not overwrite remembered settings.
native.http3_quic_source: Actual QUIC version, varint widths, stream limits, flow control, recovery and congestion/pacing source, unknown; no assumed TCP schedule.
native.http_transition_token: Actual upgrade/CONNECT protocol, unknown. RFC9931 distinguishes TLS, WebSocket, UDP/IP tunneling and untrusted TCP CONNECT; source alone does not override prohibited optimistic sending.
native.http_connect_untrusted: Actual CONNECT forwarding on behalf of untrusted TCP client, unknown. Do not assume trusted false; wait-success or Connection:close required for HTTP1.
native.http_wait_success: Actual proxy waits for successful2xx before forwarding TCP payload, unknown. Distinct from application deadline and declared source text.
native.http_connection_close: Actual Connection:close request/rejection connection behavior. HTTP1 untrusted CONNECT requires close or wait; rejecting proxy must close underlying connection under RFC9931.
native.http_transition_rejected: Actual CONNECT transition rejection state, unknown. Underlying connection must be closed by HTTP1 rejecting proxy without processing further requests.
native.payload_bytes: Actual NIS application-chunk octets, no8-byte default or65535 maximum. Full exact HTTP content/message lengths are decimal-text native fields; transport/frame capacities separately verified.

removed.rate_limit_bit_s: Removed inherited network rate limiter: HTTP has no universal link bitrate or shaping rule; any actual shaping belongs to its explicit transport/path evidence.
removed.mtu_bytes: HTTP has no universal65535 application MTU; actual TCP/QUIC path, body length, HTTP2 frame and HTTP3 varints are distinct.
removed.vlan_id: No HTTP-specific VLAN0; any actual L2 link/tag requires an independently bound physical profile.
removed.duplex: No HTTP-specific Ethernet full-duplex default; actual lower-layer link owns it.
removed.qos_priority: No HTTP-specific CAN3/Ethernet PCP default; actual scheduling/priority extension differs.
removed.sync_method: HTTP does not universally require NTP/PTP timing synchronization.
removed.queue_size: No universal HTTP256-frame queue; actual HTTP streams/implementation buffers differ.
removed.queue_policy: No universal HTTP FIFO schedule; multiplexing and actual implementation priorities differ.
removed.retransmission_enabled: HTTP application replay is separate from actual TCP/QUIC transport retransmission.
removed.retransmission_rate: No universal HTTP transport retry probability0.
removed.retry_limit: Native HTTP application retry policy/source is actual; no inherited CAN retry0.
removed.retransmission_delay_ms: No universal HTTP retransmission0ms; actual bound transport recovery must be verified.
removed.gateway_maximum_throughput: No100Mbit/s HTTP proxy/gateway default; each actual leg needs its own transport rate/evidence.
removed.gateway_input_buffer: No universal256-frame HTTP proxy input buffer.
removed.gateway_output_buffer: No universal256-frame HTTP proxy output buffer.
removed.bitrate: HTTP has no physical bitrate. Select actual TCP/QUIC and physical bindings; no inherited10M Ethernet fallback or CAN500k.

revisions: RFC9110/9112/9113/9114 June2022; RFC9204 June2022; RFC9931 March2026 updates RFC9112 optimistic transition handling
scope: Every original and new HTTP message/version/transport/body/frame/settings/role/timing parameter individually reviewed. Own HTTP1, HTTP2 and HTTP3 rules, exact decimal lengths and normative conditional initial settings; no universal physical stack/rate/MTU.

validation.suite: full_parameter_audit + standard_defaults + profile_semantics + capacity_can_schedule + parameter_review + required_parameters + physical_profiles

not_certified: Complete executed HTTP1 parser/chunking/HPACK/QPACK/QUIC stream and state machine, custom version/transport/extensions and RFC9931 transition safety
Actual TCP/TLS/QUIC and physical path capacity, stateful advertised windows, concurrency, recovery/cache/proxy and request-to-response timing
Actual functional acceptance, authentication/trust, retry idempotence and capacity execution; supplied source references alone do not prove conformance
